Lazard (2021). Lazard's Levelized Cost of Hydrogen Analysis - Version 2.0. Lazard, October 2021 (analysis conducted with support from Roland Berger). No DOI.

16-page slide report; locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 4; the cover is PDF page 1). Only the "Key Assumptions" page (p.12) is technology-level: 18 electrolyzer cases (alkaline and PEM; 1, 20 and 100 MW; low/medium/high-efficiency market-data cases) with total capex, stack capex, stack and plant lifetime, LHV efficiency, annual H2, water cost, O&M and warranty percentages, WACC and LCOH. Loaded per case with SEC derived from the printed 33 kWh/kg and efficiency. LCOH sensitivity grids (pp.9-11) are not loaded (a few to other-values). No hydrogen storage, compression, SMR or blue-hydrogen costs are printed (excluded by scope of the study). Traps: (1) price year not stated, 2021 used; (2) the three columns per scale are low/medium/high EFFICIENCY, not low/medium/high cost: capex rises with efficiency; the sensitivity pages use the medium column; (3) "Electrolyzer Utilization" 98% is called an availability factor in the text; (4) LCOH rounded to USD 0.05; (5) electricity is assumed at USD 40/MWh and escalated at 2.25%/yr inflation; (6) "MT" for annual H2 read as metric tonnes (checked: 8,585 MWh at 67% LHV and 33 kWh/kg gives about 171 t).
